pick.title: Choose the drawing
pick.hint: Pick a DXF file exported from your CAD tool. It is read in this browser and never uploaded.

dxf.too-large: This file is larger than {{limitMb}} MB.
dxf.binary: This is a binary DXF file. Export it as ASCII DXF from your CAD tool.
dxf.not-dxf: This file is not a DXF drawing.
dxf.wrong-type: Choose a file with the .dxf extension.
dxf.too-complex: This drawing is too complex to import.
dxf.empty: The drawing has no entity the console can draw.
dxf.timeout: Reading the drawing took too long. Try a simpler export.

errors.scale: Enter a scale greater than zero.
errors.extent: The plan is larger than {{limitM}} m on one axis. Check the metres per unit.

save.build: The plan does not pass the map check yet. Review the features.
save.slot: The console could not reserve a version. Try again.
save.validate: The uploaded map could not be validated. Try again.

upload.too-large: The map is larger than {{limitMb}} MB.
upload.rejected: The upload was refused, possibly because it expired. Save again.
upload.network: The upload failed on the network. Save again.
upload.timeout: The upload took too long. Save again.

mapping.title: Map the layers
mapping.scaleHint: The drawing unit is {{unit}}. Change the value only if the plan is not to scale.
mapping.scaleMissing: The drawing gives no unit. Enter how many metres one drawing unit is.
mapping.summary: {{walls}} wall lines, {{obstacles}} obstacles, {{skipped}} open lines skipped as obstacles.
mapping.preview: Preview of the walls and obstacles

edit.title: Place the features
edit.hint: Click the plan to place the selected tool. Drag a feature to move it, or use the arrow keys with Shift for one metre. V, C, W and N select a tool; Delete removes the selected feature.

panel.title: Features
panel.name: Name
panel.sizeRange: Enter a width and a height between {{min}} and {{max}} m.

edit.resizeHint: Drag a handle to resize. Keyboard: Alt+Shift+Arrow resizes the selected item by 0.1 m; Escape cancels a drag.

issues.title: Before saving
issues.badName: Workstation {{number}}: use 1 to 32 lowercase letters, digits or hyphens.
issues.badSize: Workstation {{name}} needs a width and a height between 0.1 and 50 m.
issues.badNogo: No-go zone {{number}} needs a width and a height above zero.

outside.charger: The charger is outside the plan.
outside.nogo: No-go zone {{number}} is outside the plan.

issues.protocolRefusal: The plan does not pass the site map check yet. Review the features.

edit.itemSized: {{item}}, x {{x}} m, y {{y}} m, {{width}} by {{height}} m

discard.title: Discard the unsaved draft?
discard.message: The drawing and the features placed on it are not saved. Closing the sheet drops them.

profile.name: Site name
profile.saveFailed: The name could not be saved. Try again.
profile.loadFailed: The site could not be loaded. Try again.
profile.invalidName: Use 1 to {{max}} characters, without angle brackets or control characters.

saved.title: Version {{version}} is validated
saved.hint: The map is stored and checked. Activate it to make the planner use it.
saved.activated: Version {{version}} is now the active map.
saved.activateConflict: The map changed before activation. Refresh the versions and try again.
saved.activateFailed: The map could not be activated. Try again.

versions.title: Map versions
versions.empty: No map version yet. Save a drawing from the editor to create one.
versions.activated: Version {{version}} is now the active map.

errors.load: The versions could not be loaded. Try again.
errors.validate: The version could not be validated. Try again.
errors.download: The download could not start. Try again.
errors.activateConflict: The map changed before activation. Refresh the versions and try again.
errors.activateFailed: The map could not be activated. Try again.
